title: Metric-measure limits of subcritical FK and spanning-tree planar maps
main_claim: For each fixed q in (0,4) (FK-weighted maps, gamma in (sqrt2,2) with q=2+2cos(pi gamma^2/2)) and for uniform spanning-tree-decorated maps (gamma=sqrt2), there are deterministic a_n -> 0 such that (V(M_n), a_n d_n, degree measure) converges in law in GHP to the unit-area gamma-LQG sphere (S, D_h, mu_h), along all n. This resolves the finite spherical FK and spanning-tree cases of Gwynne-Miller Conjecture 1.7.
coverage:
The paper is about 16.7k lines of LaTeX, so this audit is partial. What I read and checked:
(1) Introduction and parameter identities. Checked l(M,A)=2k(A)+|A|-|V| by Euler. Checked q<->gamma at q=1 (gamma^2=8/3) and q=2 (gamma^2=3). Checked rho=b/(1-b)=sqrt(q)/2=-cos(pi gamma^2/4).
(2) The whole of the sampling/normalization section (02-measured-convergence), line by line: the GHP criterion from sample arrays plus covering radii (multinomial/Cauchy-Schwarz cell bound, finite-array continuity), common completion, the common-parameter lemma, the arctan center, and deterministic normalization, including the a_n -> 0 step.
(3) Exponent bookkeeping in the arms/entropy section (05-arms-entropy). d_2=pi/(2 arccos(-rho))=2/gamma^2, so beta=1/2+d_2>1 exactly when gamma<2. The fixed-code charge sum (k/2+d_k) with d_k>=k d_2/2 needs d_1=1/2>=1/gamma^2, which holds because gamma>=sqrt2. Read the occupancy-tail union bound and the T(U)<=2T(V) shift argument.
(4) The Polynomial bound after propagation lemma (comp:polynomial-algebra): algebra checked.
(5) The FK sphere section: inputs F1-F3, the edge-mesh argument, separation/profile lemma, root identification, and the two-root tight-metric-net contradiction (p_0=p_1). Subsequential and full-sequence normalization.
(6) Tree sphere: checked the excursion-density formula, the reflection identity and the return asymptotic N^3 q_N(0,0) -> 32/pi numerically (9.81 at N=200, 10.11 at N=1000, against 10.19). Read the density bound scaling, the degree-measure tour lemma, the sphere-identification upper and lower bounds with endpoint cut-outs, and the final normalization.
(7) common-rigidity lines 1-520: optimal constants, transport of comparison constants, Amplification and Equality-tangent propositions (a Gwynne-Miller-style saving argument), restricted Cameron-Martin transfer (density exp{W_f(h)+1/2||f||^2} checked), weighted output multiplicity, and the gate-forcing statement.

Not verified line by line:
- the rest of the forcing/rigidity core (common-rigidity about lines 520-1524, including the catalogue availability and the identification theorem proof)
- common-annuli, common-passage, relative units
- local kernels (03)
- protected charts/topology (02-*)
- finite views (06, 2345 lines), endpoint modulus (07)
- the tree certificates, comparison and bootstrap sections
- the remaining arms fragments

Nothing in the parts I checked failed, but the paper's hardest technical steps are mostly in the sections not verified.
